name: Rock Crabs (North of Rellekka)
accessNote: Rock Crabs are found on the coast directly north of Rellekka, with very plentiful spawn points; other spawns exist at Waterbirth Island, west of Mount Quidamortem, in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, and in the Brine Rat Cavern. They appear as inactive 'rocks' until a player stands adjacent, then become aggressive; aggression must be reset by leaving and returning after 10 minutes.
